title: Master Jan Hus Preaching at the Bethlehem Chapel (Kázání Mistra Jana Husa v kapli Betlémské)

museum.name: museum collection of the Prague City Gallery

source.label: Wikipedia: The Slav Epic, “a cycle of 20 large canvases painted … between 1910 and 1928”
Wikipedia: “The cycle depicts the mythology and history of Czechs and other Slavic peoples”
Wikidata record: oil paint on canvas

work.text: The people of all elements of society attended the preaching of Jan Hus, paying the most careful attention to his words, for he it was who unveiled the vicious doings of those who claimed to be servants of God, but lived unrighteous lives and countenanced wicked practices.

moment.text: He grew up in an environment of intense Czech nationalism in all the arts, from music to literature and painting.

matters.text: Let it announce to foreign friends – and even to enemies – who we were, who we are, and what we hope for. May the strength of the Slav spirit command their respect, because from respect, love is born.
